data.one_liner: On-device Whisper.cpp speech transcription plugin for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Transcribes completed audio files locally using Whisper.cpp without sending data to a remote server. Supports model downloads, timestamps, and voice activity detection.
use_when: You need on-device audio transcription without relying on cloud APIs.
Your application works with file-based batch audio processing.
avoid_when: You require real-time streaming speech-to-text directly while recording.
You want built-in microphone UI capture controls.
strengths: Runs completely on-device across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Supports Large-v3-Turbo models and optional CoreML/Metal acceleration on Apple platforms.
weaknesses: Does not support partial streaming transcription tokens while recording.
Requires manual management of GGML model files and optional CoreML assets.
data.setup_notes: Requires downloading or bundling a GGML .bin model file in app-writable storage. Optionally register a companion converter like whisper_ggml_plus_ffmpeg for non-WAV audio formats.
